description: EDIT A FINISHED DOCUMENT: read the blocks it was built from, change them, and build it again UNDER THE SAME NAME — so the shelf keeps one document rather than a family of near copies. This is the same operation the person does in the report editor. Call it with only a `name` to read the blocks back; pass `blocks` to replace them. The run’s own context — the address, the moment, the conditions the application was under — is carried over from the original and cannot be rewritten here, because those are facts about the run rather than about the wording. A report saved before its source was kept has nothing to edit, and says so.
